title: Add MCP server

context.summary: Create MCP tool definitions and a server registry that calls Mindory through the HTTP API boundary.
context.background: TASK-10 added memory/context API surfaces. TASK-11 exposes agent-facing MCP tools without bypassing the HTTP API source-of-truth rule.

in: Add @mindory/mcp exports for HTTP client, tool registry and server builder.
Define MCP tools for sessions, memories, documents and context build.
Implement tool calls over the Mindory HTTP API using fetch.
Represent document upload through multipart FormData from text or base64 content.
Add MCP API URL/token configuration to config, .env.example and Docker Compose.
Keep stdio SDK transport as an explicit placeholder until runtime dependencies are installed.
Add MCP validation to repository checks.
Update MCP, API, configuration and README docs.
out: Implement API endpoints that are still future tasks.
Add direct database, queue, vector or storage access from MCP.
Install dependencies if pnpm is unavailable in the local environment.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/mcp exports a MindoryApiClient, tool definitions, tool registry and server builder.
The MCP tool list includes session, memory, document and context tools from the PRD.
MCP tool calls go through HTTP API paths rather than direct database/core persistence.
MCP memory_remember exposes sourceRefs and memory_recall uses the memory search endpoint.
MCP document_upload can send multipart upload content from utf8 or base64 input.
MCP config includes API URL and optional API token in config, .env.example and Docker Compose.
The stdio transport remains an explicit not-implemented placeholder until SDK/runtime wiring is added.
Documentation describes the current MCP boundary.

commands: ls apps/mcp/src/http-client.ts apps/mcp/src/tools.ts apps/mcp/src/server.ts apps/mcp/src/stdio.ts scripts/validate-mcp-server.js
manual_checks: Confirm MCP code calls HTTP paths and does not import @mindory/db or Drizzle.
Confirm stdio SDK transport is not falsely marked runnable.
Confirm CLI and Hermes behavior remain untouched.

risks: Local pnpm is unavailable in the current environment, so TypeScript execution may need to wait until dependencies are installed.
MCP transport is structurally scaffolded but not runnable over @modelcontextprotocol/sdk in this task.
Some MCP tools point at planned HTTP endpoints that are not implemented by the API skeleton yet.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
